summary: Per-frame rendering update on a render/scene manager object: runs an entry stub, clears per-sub-node flags through a descriptor array (+0x150, stride 24) and a tree linked list (+0x15C), conditionally clears buffer present/dirty flags at +0xEC (bits 0x800 / mask 0xFFBFF7FF) and dispatches dirty-list traversal, updates audio nodes when the +0x16C count is positive, walks the render-node linked list rooted at +0xF8, then refreshes animation time at +0xF0 via sub_556730 and feeds it to D3DAnimationTimeUpdate and AddFloatToAnimationChannels.

operations.description: Entry call to EmptyStub_0170 with no arguments before any state is touched.
If the sub-node descriptor count at +0x14C is greater than zero, run the descriptor array traversal.
Iterate the descriptor array at +0x150 in 24-byte steps; for each descriptor take the pointer stored at descriptor+16 and call sub_5503A0 on it when non-null (clears a per-sub-node flag).
Walk the tree/sub-node linked list rooted at +0x15C, advancing through the node's next pointer at +0x34, clearing bit 8 at node+0x24 on every node.
If the render-flag bitmask at +0xEC has the 0x800 present bit set, run the buffer-clear and dirty-mark path.
Call ClearBuffersLoop(this) when the present flag is set.
If the global bitmask unk_600000 ANDed with the +0xEC render flags is nonzero, call NestedLinkedListTraversalWithDirtyMark(this, render-node list head at +0xF8).
Clear the present/dirty bits from the render-flag mask at +0xEC using AND with 0xFFBFF7FF.
Reset the global buffer/reset flag dword_8CEF70 to zero.
If the global gate flag dword_8B8DF0 is zero, call VTableGetterWrapper(dword_8B78A0) to fetch a graphics/sound vtable.
If the audio node count at +0x16C is greater than zero, call AudioNodeIterator(this).
Walk the render-node linked list rooted at +0xF8 via the next pointer at node+0x1B8, calling sub_556E70(node, this) for each node.
If dword_8B8DF0 is still zero, call VTableDispatchGetter(dword_8B78A0) to dispatch into the fetched vtable.
Compute the current animation time by calling sub_556730(-1) and store it at +0xF0.
Call D3DAnimationTimeUpdate(this, animation time) with the freshly computed time.
Return the result of AddFloatToAnimationChannels(this, animation time at +0xF0), the final per-frame animation channel update.
